options.text: Corrosion of iron can be minimised by forming a contact with another metal with a higher reduction potential
Corrosion of iron can be minimised by forming an impermeable barrier at its surface
Iron corrodes more rapidly in salt water because its electrochemical potential is higher

solution.text: Corrosion of iron can be minimised by forming a contact with another metal with a lower reduction potential. Corrosion of iron can be minimised by forming an impermeable barrier at its surface.
